definitions.explanation: Describes something that is very weak or subtle, barely detectable by the senses. Used for sounds, light, smells, movements, or abstract things like hope or memory.

examples.japanese: {微|かす}かな⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧がした。
{微|かす}かな⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいた→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: A faint light was streaming in through the window.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{微|かす}かな⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{澄|す}ました→澄ます：16578_sumasu⟧。
examples.english: I could hear faint music from far away, so I listened carefully.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes things that are barely perceptible — sounds, light, smells, sensations, or abstract things like hope or memory. The adverbial form {微|かす}かに is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微|かす}かな⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ (faint sound)
- {微|かす}かな⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ (faint light)
- {微|かす}かな⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (faint fragrance)
- {微|かす}かな⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧ (faint hope)
- {微|かす}かな⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (faint memory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{僅|わず}か→僅か：03792_wazuka⟧な: emphasizes smallness in quantity or degree, while {微|かす}かな emphasizes weak perceptibility
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: thin, pale — describes visual faintness more than sensory faintness
